overview_description.description:
FLOAT is a very visual Social Sharing Advertising Platform! FLOAT takes the concept of a community corkboard and brings that experience to the Internet. Users can post content to various geographically organized boards, which can be ads, memes, music, movies and more, and users can move, cover and take down this content just like on a real board. The only exception to this are paid ads that are pinned to the board for a specific length of time.

The entire network is cloud based and sharing content is legal by having protected content “float” to each user and only one end user has access to the owned content. The more users that own the same content increases the number of users that can share that content.

Each user has a personal board that they can use to post content to for their friends to enjoy and also their friends can post content on these boards as well.
Sound boards are a great way for users to share music!

The possibilities are limitless.

The main difference that sets FLOAT apart from every other social media platform is that the space that is used is limited by the amount that the user can scroll left and right and up and down. The prime space is of course what shows up on the screen when the user enters the site.

I believe that FLOAT will change the way we view and share content on the Internet!
